title: 3.11.2: Key Equations
originalText:
Key Equations

            general form of a quadratic function	
            \(f(x)=a{x}^{2}+bx+c\)	

            the quadratic formula	
            \(x=\frac{−b±\sqrt{{b}^{2}−4ac}}{2a}\)	

            standard form of a quadratic function	
            \(f(x)=a{(x−h)}^{2}+k\)	

            general form of a polynomial function	
            \(f(x)={a}_{n}{x}^{n}+{a}_{n-1}{x}^{n-1}+...+{a}_{2}{x}^{2}+{a}_{1}x+{a}_{1}\)	

            Division Algorithm	
            \(f(x)=d(x)q(x)+r(x)\) where \(q(x)≠0\)	

            Rational Function	
            \(f(x)=\frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}=\frac{{a}_{p}{x}^{p}+{a}_{p−1}{x}^{p−1}+...+{a}_{1}x+{a}_{0}}{{b}_{q}{x}^{q}+{b}_{q−1}{x}^{q−1}+...+{b}_{1}x+{b}_{0}}, Q(x)≠0\)	

            Direct variation	
            \(y=k{x}^{n},kis a nonzero constant.\)	

            Inverse variation	
            \(y=\frac{k}{{x}^{n}},kis a nonzero constant.\)
